summary.text: Jeff Spiegelman of Clayton was first elected in 2012 to represent the 11th District in the Delaware House of Representatives, and was chosen House Minority Whip by House Republicans in November 2024.

paragraphs.text: Spiegelman is a commercial realtor and property appraiser and a Major in the Civil Air Patrol.
Spiegelman graduated from Smyrna High School in 2001, Ithaca College (B.S.) in 2005 and Norwich University (M.A.) in 2007.
